annotations.title: XML to JSON converter: convert an XML document into JSON

description: XML to JSON for any XML document: attributes become "@name" keys, text becomes "#text" (or the value itself when an element only holds text), and repeated child elements become arrays. DOCTYPEs and external entities are refused, so nothing outside the document is ever loaded. Up to 100,000 characters. Use to read XML feeds, SOAP responses and config files in an agent. Example: xml=<order id="7"><item sku="a1">Pen</item><item sku="b2">Ink</item></order>. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
